title: Constructible topology on algebraic-space point classes
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $F$ be a presheaf of sets on schemes over $S$ as used in [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Use its point classes and the maps $|a|:|T|\to|F|$ of [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Define the constructible point topology of $F$ as the final topology for all representable etale maps $a:h_T\to F$ with $T$ affine, where $|T|$ has the topology generated by quasi-compact open subsets and their complements [def-weil-pbc-constructible-topology]. Thus a subset is open exactly when its inverse image under every such $|a|$ is constructible open. For an algebraic space this is its atlas constructible topology.

source.place: Rydh (author version 2010-03-03), Remark (1.8), printed pp.6--7; constructible topologies on affine charts and quotient topology on spaces. Read online at https://davidrydh.se/papers/submersion20100305.pdf.
